content.user_title: Optimize AI Context for Cost and Quality
content.value_statement: Long AI sessions waste tokens and lose important context. This skill provides measured strategies for budgeting, masking, compaction, caching, retrieval, and partitioning.
actual_capabilities: Selects optimization tactics based on which context category consumes the token budget.
Defines thresholds for compaction, masking, and task partitioning.
Structures stable prompt prefixes to improve KV-cache reuse.
Preserves retrievable references when masking verbose tool outputs.
Provides Python utilities for token estimates, summaries, budgets, and cache metrics.
Defines metrics for evaluating token reduction, quality, latency, and cache performance.
limitations: Token estimates use a simple English character heuristic, not model-specific tokenization.
Summarization utilities use extraction and truncation heuristics, not semantic model summaries.
Observation storage is in memory and does not persist across processes.
Performance targets require validation against each model, workload, and provider.

use_cases.title: Control production agent costs
use_cases.description: Create token budgets and optimization triggers for long-running agent workflows.

use_cases.title: Preserve long research sessions
use_cases.description: Mask resolved outputs and compact older material while keeping key evidence retrievable.

use_cases.title: Improve prompt cache reuse
use_cases.description: Reorder stable and dynamic prompt content to increase prefix cache hit rates.

prompt_templates.title: Review my context usage
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this conversation context. Identify the largest token categories and recommend one low-risk optimization with a measurement plan.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of an existing conversation

prompt_templates.title: Create a token budget
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a token budget for this agent workflow: [workflow]. Allocate space by category, reserve output capacity, and define optimization triggers.

prompt_templates.title: Design masking and compaction
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these message and tool-output patterns: [patterns]. Define what to preserve, mask, compact, and retrieve, with quality checks.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize a multi-agent architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate this multi-agent architecture: [architecture]. Estimate context costs, improve prefix stability, scope retrieval, partition work, and define measurable acceptance thresholds.

output_examples.input: Our support agent reaches 85% context usage because tool logs dominate the conversation.
output_examples.output: Mask resolved tool logs after three turns, retain error details during active debugging, and compact history at 70 to 80 percent utilization.

output_examples.input: Our repeated requests have low prompt cache hit rates.
output: Keep system instructions and tool definitions byte-stable.
Move timestamps, session identifiers, and request-specific data after the stable prefix.
Measure cache hit rate before and after deployment.

output_examples.input: A document analysis task exceeds one model context window.
output_examples.output: Partition independent document groups across focused agents, require structured results, and include coordinator overhead in the total token estimate.

best_practices: Measure context composition and answer quality before selecting an optimization.
Mask low-value observations before applying lossy compaction.
Validate token savings, quality, latency, and cache performance after each change.
anti_patterns: Do not compact the system prompt or remove current task constraints.
Do not mask recent errors while debugging remains active.
Do not partition small tasks when coordination costs exceed context savings.

faq.question: When should I optimize context?
faq.answer: Optimize when measured token use, cost, latency, or answer quality shows a clear constraint.

faq.question: Does this skill call external services?
faq.answer: No. The included Python utilities use only local standard-library operations.

faq.question: Can it count tokens exactly?
faq.answer: No. The included estimator is approximate. Use the target model tokenizer for production measurements.

faq.question: What content should never be masked?
faq.answer: Keep current goals, user constraints, recent observations, active reasoning evidence, and unresolved error details.

faq.question: When is task partitioning useful?
faq.answer: Use partitioning when independent subtasks exceed one context window and savings justify coordination overhead.

faq.question: How do I verify an optimization?
faq.answer: Compare token use, answer quality, latency, cost, and cache hit rates against a measured baseline.
